purpose: Close the review-only runtime-mapping phase after every one of the 192 semantic findings has a terminal runtime disposition.
closure_guards: all 192 finding IDs are unique and runtime-terminal
reviewed mappings are generated only from semantic runtime_match=reviewed
the 77 runtime mapping IDs equal the 77 semantic reviewed IDs exactly
candidate and not_designed are both zero
no executable matcher is implemented in Phase A
trigger descriptions remain non-executable review knowledge
selected XSD result remains normative and no known-issue mapping may override PASS/FAIL
candidate/integration authorities remain provenance-separated from official release authorities
all manifest and CURRENT_STATE counters agree
complete root XSD regression remains green
no XSD mutation is part of closure

initial_gate_attempt.reason: Gate-design assertion incorrectly required candidate/integration wording to be duplicated in free-text scope notes/profile names although authority=candidate_integration was already canonical.

closure_gate.note: Corrected provenance gate compares runtime mapping profile_scope objects exactly to semantic-registry version_scope objects instead of inferring authority from prose.
